text: Based on the provided data, there is insufficient evidence to confirm that the property stayed completely free of fires throughout the entire period from 2026-10-05 to 2026-11-04. While no thermal anomalies were detected by the sensors from 2026-10-05 to 2026-11-03, there is a temporal gap in the data from 2026-11-03 to 2026-11-04 due to the latest NRT file update not being published yet. Therefore, we cannot definitively say that there were no fires during this gap. Small, short, cool, or cloud-obscured fires may not have been detected by the sensors.
